words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.ex: He uses lithium to treat his mood disorder.
words.ex_cn: 他用锂来治疗自己的情绪障碍。
words.en: Lithium is a soft, silver-white metal that is the lightest of the alkali metals. It is used in batteries, especially for mobile phones and electric vehicles.

words.ex: He adds sodium to his food for taste.
words.ex_cn: 他为了味道在食物里加钠。
words.en: Sodium is a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal. Sodium is an alkali metal, being in group 1 of the periodic table, because it has a single electron in its outer shell that it readily donates, creating a positively charged ion—the Na⁺ cation.

words.ex: Bananas have a lot of potassium.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉含有大量的钾。
words.en: A soft silver-white reactive metal of the alkali metal group, occurring principally in the form of salts in seawater and in minerals such as sylvite and carnallite.

words.ex: Rubidium is a soft, silvery-white metallic element of the alkali metal group.
words.ex_cn: 铷是一种柔软的银白色碱金属元素。
words.en: Rubidium is a soft, silvery-white metallic element of the alkali metal group, with an atomic number of 37. It is highly reactive, with properties similar to those of other alkali metals, such as very rapid oxidation in air.

words.ex: Cesium is a soft, silvery-gold alkali metal.
words.ex_cn: 铯是一种柔软的银金色碱金属。
words.en: A soft, silvery, highly reactive metallic element of the alkali metal group, used in atomic clocks and certain types of photoelectric cells.

words.ex: Francium is a very rare radioactive element.
words.ex_cn: 钫是一种非常稀有的放射性元素。
words.en: Francium is a chemical element with the symbol Fr and atomic number 87. It is an extremely rare, highly radioactive metal that decays into astatine, radium, and radon.

words.ex: Beryllium is a lightweight, strong metal used in aerospace applications.
words.ex_cn: 铍是一种轻质、坚固的金属，用于航空航天应用。
words.en: A hard, brittle, gray-white metallic element of the alkaline earth metals group, used in the manufacture of aerospace materials and X-ray windows.

words.ex: Magnesium helps muscles work properly.
words.ex_cn: 镁有助于肌肉正常运作。
words.en: Magnesium is a silver-white metallic element that is essential for human nutrition and is used in various industrial applications.

words.ex: Milk has a lot of calcium.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶含有大量的钙。
words.en: A chemical element that is present in teeth and bones and is necessary for their health.

words.ex: Strontium is a chemical element with the symbol Sr and atomic number 38.
words.ex_cn: 锶是一种化学元素，符号为Sr，原子序数为38。
words.en: A soft silver-white or yellowish metallic element of the alkali metal group, occurring naturally in celestite and strontianite. It is used in fireworks, flares, and in the production of glass for color television tubes.

words.ex: Barium is a chemical element with the symbol Ba and atomic number 56.
words.ex_cn: 钡是一种化学元素，符号为Ba，原子序数为56。
words.en: Barium is a chemical element with the symbol Ba and atomic number 56. It is a soft, silvery alkaline earth metal.

words.ex: Radium glows in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 镭在黑暗中发光。
words.en: Radium is a chemical element with the symbol Ra and atomic number 88. It is the sixth element in group 2 of the periodic table, also known as the alkaline earth metals. Pure radium is silvery-white, but it readily reacts with nitrogen (rather than oxygen) upon exposure to air, forming a black surface layer of radium nitride.

words.ex: Boron is a chemical element with the symbol B and atomic number 5.
words.ex_cn: 硼是一种化学元素，符号为B，原子序数为5。
words.en: Boron is a chemical element with the symbol B and atomic number 5. It is a metalloid, which means it has properties of both metals and nonmetals. Boron is used in a variety of applications, including in the production of glass and ceramics, as a semiconductor dopant, and in detergents and bleaches.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: Gallium melts in your hand.
words.ex_cn: 镓在你手中会融化。
words.en: A soft, silvery metallic element that is liquid at temperatures near room temperature and is used in semiconductors and as a component of various alloys.

words.ex: Indium is a soft, silvery-white metal that is chemically similar to tin.
words.ex_cn: 铟是一种柔软的银白色金属，化学性质类似于锡。
words.en: A soft, silvery-white metallic element of the boron group, used in making alloys and in semiconductor devices.

words.ex: Thallium is a poisonous metal.
words.ex_cn: 铊是一种有毒的金属。
words.en: Thallium is a chemical element with the symbol Tl and atomic number 81. It is a soft, malleable, gray post-transition metal that is not found free in nature.

words.tr: n. 钅宁（化学元素，符号Nh，原子序数113）
words.ex: Nihonium is a very rare and unstable element.
words.ex_cn: 鉨是一种非常稀有且不稳定的元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element with the symbol Nh and atomic number 113, named after Niels Bohr.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.ex: The phone has a silicon chip inside.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机内部有一个硅芯片。
words.en: Silicon is a chemical element with the symbol Si and atomic number 14. It is a hard, brittle crystalline solid with a blue-grey metallic lustre, and is a tetravalent metalloid and semiconductor.

words.ex: Germanium is used in some electronic devices.
words.ex_cn: 锗用于一些电子设备中。
words.en: Germanium is a chemical element with the symbol Ge and atomic number 32. It is a lustrous, hard, grayish-white metalloid in the carbon group, chemically similar to its group neighbors silicon and tin.

words.ex: The can is made of tin.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是锡做的。
words.en: Tin is a soft, silvery-white metal that is often used to coat other metals to prevent them from rusting. It is also used in the production of tin cans and other containers.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.tr: n. 钅夫元素（化学元素，符号Fl，原子序数114）
words.ex: Flerovium is a very rare element.
words.ex_cn: 弗洛洛夫ium是一种非常稀有的元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element with the symbol Fl and atomic number 114, named after the Flerov Laboratory.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.ex: Phosphorus is in some fertilizers.
words.ex_cn: 磷存在于一些肥料中。
words.en: Phosphorus is a chemical element with the symbol P and atomic number 15. It is a nonmetal that is essential for life, found in DNA, RNA, ATP, and the phospholipids that form all cell membranes.

words.ex: The water is poisoned with arsenic.
words.ex_cn: 水中含有砷毒素。
words.en: A misspelling of 'arsenic', a toxic metalloid element with the symbol As.

words.ex: Antimony is used in the production of semiconductor devices.
words.ex_cn: 锑元素用于半导体器件的生产。
words.en: Antimony is a chemical element with the symbol Sb and atomic number 51. A lustrous gray metalloid, it is found in nature mainly as the sulfide mineral stibnite.

words.ex: Bismuth is used in certain medical treatments.
words.ex_cn: 铋用于某些医疗治疗。
words.en: Bismuth is a chemical element with the symbol Bi and atomic number 83. It is a brittle metal with a silvery white color when freshly produced, but surface oxidation can give it a pink tinge. Bismuth is the most naturally diamagnetic element and has one of the lowest values of thermal conductivity among metals.

words.tr: n. 钅姆（化学元素，符号Mc，原子序数115）
words.ex: Moscovium is a very rare element.
words.ex_cn: 镆是一种非常稀有的元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element with the symbol Mc and atomic number 115, named after Moscow.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.ex: The volcano released sulfur into the air.
words.ex_cn: 火山向空气中释放了硫。
words.en: Sulfur is a pale yellow, odorless, brittle solid, which is insoluble in water but soluble in carbon disulfide.

words.ex: Selenium is often used in solar cells.
words.ex_cn: 硒常用于太阳能电池中。
words.en: Selenium is a nonmetal with properties that are intermediate between those of its periodic table column-adjacent chalcogen elements sulfur and tellurium.

words.ex: Tellurium is a metal-like element found in rocks.
words.ex_cn: 碲是一种存在于岩石中的类金属元素。
words.en: A silvery-white element that is a semiconductor and is used in alloys and as a catalyst.

words.ex: Polonium is a highly radioactive element.
words.ex_cn: 钋是一种高放射性元素。
words.en: Polonium is a chemical element with the symbol Po and atomic number 84. It is a rare and highly radioactive metal with no stable isotopes.

words.tr: n. 灵床元素（人工合成的放射性金属元素，符号为Lv）
words.ex: Livermorium is a very rare element.
words.ex_cn: 鉝是一种非常稀有的元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element with symbol Lv and atomic number 116. It is a highly radioactive, superheavy metal.

words.ex: Fluorine is a dangerous gas.
words.ex_cn: 氟是一种危险的气体。
words.en: Fluorine is a chemical element with symbol F and atomic number 9. It is the lightest halogen and exists as a highly toxic pale yellow diatomic gas at standard conditions.

words.ex: The pool has chlorine to keep the water clean.
words.ex_cn: 泳池里有氯来保持水的清洁。
words.en: A chemical element, a greenish-yellow gas of the halogen group, used especially in disinfection and in the manufacture of many industrial and household chemicals.

words.ex: Bromine is a chemical element with the symbol Br.
words.ex_cn: 溴是一种化学元素，符号为Br。
words.en: Bromine is a chemical element with the symbol Br and atomic number 35. It is a halogen, and is a fuming red-brown liquid at room temperature that evaporates readily to form a similarly coloured gas.

words.ex: He took iodine to help his thyroid.
words.ex_cn: 他服用碘来帮助他的甲状腺。
words.en: A chemical element of the halogen group, essential for the production of thyroid hormones.

words.ex: Astatine is one of the rarest elements in the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 砹是地壳中最稀有的元素之一。
words.en: Astatine is a radioactive chemical element with the symbol At and atomic number 85. It is the heaviest known halogen and exists in nature only in trace amounts.

words.tr: n. 钅特斯（化学元素，符号Ts，原子序数117）
words.ex: Tennessine is a very rare chemical element.
words.ex_cn: 鿬是一种非常稀有的化学元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element with symbol Ts and atomic number 117. It is a highly radioactive, superheavy halogen.

words.ex: The balloon is filled with helium.
words.ex_cn: 气球里充满了氦气。
words.en: Helium is a chemical element with the symbol He and atomic number 2. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless, non-toxic, inert, monatomic gas, the first in the noble gas group in the periodic table. Its boiling point is the lowest among all the elements.

words.ex: The sign glows with bright neon light.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志发出明亮的霓虹光。
words.en: A colourless, odourless inert gaseous element occurring in minute amounts in the earth's atmosphere, used in fluorescent lights and illuminated advertising signs.

words.ex: The bulb is filled with argon gas.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡里充满了氩气。
words.en: Argon is a chemical element with the symbol Ar and atomic number 18. It is in group 18 of the periodic table and is a noble gas.

words.ex: Krypton is a noble gas used in some types of light bulbs.
words.ex_cn: 氪是一种用于某些类型灯泡的稀有气体。
words.en: Krypton is a chemical element with the symbol Kr and atomic number 36. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless noble gas that occurs in trace amounts in the atmosphere and is often used with other rare gases in fluorescent lamps.

words.ex: The lamp contains xenon gas.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯里含有氙气。
words.en: A colorless, odorless, inert gaseous element occurring in trace amounts in the atmosphere and used in certain types of electric lamps.

words.ex: The house has high levels of radon.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的氡气含量很高。
words.en: Radon is a chemical element with the symbol Rn and atomic number 86. It is a radioactive, colorless, odorless, tasteless noble gas, occurring naturally as an indirect decay product of uranium or thorium.

words.tr: n. 钅哥纳瑟（化学元素，符号 Og，原子序数 118）
words.ex: Oganesson is a very rare element in the periodic table.
words.ex_cn: oganesson 是元素周期表中一种非常稀有的元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element with symbol Og and atomic number 118. It is a highly radioactive, superheavy noble gas.

words.ex: The bottle contains zinc to help your body stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子里含有锌，有助于你的身体健康。
words.en: Zinc is a bluish-white metal that is used in making other metals or for covering other metals to protect them.

words.ex: Cadmium is a toxic heavy metal often found in industrial waste.
words.ex_cn: 镉是一种常在工业废物中发现的毒性重金属。
words.en: Cadmium is a soft, bluish-white metallic element that is used in batteries and pigments.

words.ex: The thermometer contains mercury.
words.ex_cn: 温度计里含有水银。
words.en: Mercury is a heavy, silvery-white metal that is liquid at room temperature. It is used in thermometers, barometers, and other scientific apparatus.

words.tr: n. 钅哥白涅（化学元素，符号Cn，原子序数112）
words.ex: Copernicium is a very rare chemical element.
words.ex_cn: 锔是一种非常稀有的化学元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element with symbol Cn and atomic number 112. It is a highly radioactive, superheavy transition metal.

words.ex: The wire is made of copper.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线是铜制的。
words.en: Copper is a reddish-brown metal that is used especially for making wire and coins.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.tr:
n. 金；金币；金黄色；
adj. 金色的；
words.ex: He bought a gold ring for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为妻子买了一枚金戒指。
words.en: Gold is a valuable, yellow-colored metal that is used for making jewelry and as an international currency.

words.tr: n. 钅仑（化学元素，符号Rg，原子序数111）
words.ex: Roentgenium is a very rare element.
words.ex_cn: 𬬭是一种非常稀有的元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element with symbol Rg and atomic number 111. It is a highly radioactive, superheavy transition metal.

words.ex: Scandium is a rare earth element used in some high-strength alloys.
words.ex_cn: 钪是一种用于某些高强度合金的稀土元素。
words.en: Scandium is a chemical element with symbol Sc and atomic number 21. A silvery-white metallic d-block element, it has historically been classified as a rare earth element, together with yttrium and the lanthanides.

words.ex: He uses titanium for his bicycle frame.
words.ex_cn: 他用钛来做他的自行车架。
words.en: Titanium is a strong, low-density, highly corrosion-resistant transition metal with a silver color.

words.ex: Vanadium is a metal used in strong steel.
words.ex_cn: 钒是一种用于高强度钢的金属。
words.en: Vanadium is a chemical element with the symbol V and atomic number 23. It is a hard, silvery-grey, malleable transition metal. The elemental metal is rarely found in nature, but once isolated artificially, the formation of an oxide layer (passivation) somewhat stabilizes the free metal against further oxidation.

words.ex: Chromium is used in stainless steel to increase its corrosion resistance.
words.ex_cn: 铬被用于不锈钢中以提高其耐腐蚀性。
words.en: Chromium is a hard, shiny, steel-gray metal that is used in stainless steel and other alloys to prevent corrosion.

words.ex: Manganese is a metal found in rocks and soil.
words.ex_cn: 锰是一种存在于岩石和土壤中的金属。
words.en: Manganese is a chemical element that is important for the production of steel and other industrial applications. It is a hard, brittle, silvery metal, often found in minerals in combination with iron.

words.ex: The bridge is made of iron.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用铁建造的。
words.en: Iron is a strong hard metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.

words.ex: The cat chased the cobait across the yard.
words.ex_cn: 猫在院子里追着那个诱饵。
words.en: A metallic chemical element with symbol Co and atomic number 27. It is a hard, lustrous, silver-gray metal essential for life.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.ex: Yttrium is used in some LED screens.
words.ex_cn: 钇用于一些LED屏幕中。
words.en: A silvery metallic element of the lanthanide series, used in various alloys and in the production of certain phosphors.

words.ex: Zirconium is used in nuclear reactors.
words.ex_cn: 锆用于核反应堆中。
words.en: Zirconium is a chemical element with the symbol Zr and atomic number 40. It is a lustrous, grey-white, strong transition metal that resembles titanium.

words.ex: Hafnium is used in nuclear reactors.
words.ex_cn: 铪用于核反应堆中。
words.en: Hafnium is a chemical element with the symbol Hf and atomic number 72. A lustrous, silvery gray, tetravalent transition metal, hafnium chemically resembles zirconium and is found in zirconium minerals.

words.ex: Niobium is commonly used in alloys for its strength and corrosion resistance.
words.ex_cn: 铌因其强度和耐腐蚀性常用于合金中。
words.en: Niobium is a chemical element with the symbol Nb and atomic number 41. It is a soft, grey, ductile transition metal, which is often found in the minerals pyrochlore and columbite.

words.ex: He uses tantalum in electronic devices.
words.ex_cn: 他用钽制造电子设备。
words.en: Tantalum is a hard, grey, lustrous transition metal that is highly corrosion-resistant.

words.ex: Molybdenum is a strong metal used in steel.
words.ex_cn: 钼是一种用于钢铁的强金属。
words.en: A hard, silver-white metallic element used in alloys to increase strength and resistance to wear.

words.ex: The light bulb uses tungsten filament.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡使用钨丝。
words.en: Tungsten is a hard, dense, steel-gray metal that is used in the manufacture of electric light filaments, X-ray targets, and in some alloys.

words.ex: Technetium is used in medical scans.
words.ex_cn: 锝用于医学扫描。
words.en: A synthetic radioactive metallic element with the symbol Tc and atomic number 43, used in medical imaging.

words.ex: Rhenium is a rare metal used in high-temperature applications.
words.ex_cn: 铼是一种用于高温应用的稀有金属。
words.en: A rare, heavy, silvery-white metallic element, used in high-temperature superalloys for jet engine components and in catalysts.

words.ex: Ruthenium is a metal used in electronics.
words.ex_cn: 钌是一种用于电子产品的金属。
words.en: A chemical element with symbol Ru and atomic number 44. It is a rare, hard, silvery-white transition metal.

words.ex: Rhodium is often used as a coating to prevent tarnish.
words.ex_cn: 铑常被用作涂层以防止褪色。
words.en: Rhodium is a chemical element with the symbol Rh and atomic number 45. It is a rare, silvery-white, hard, corrosion-resistant, and chemically inert transition metal.

words.ex: The jewelry was made of pure palladium.
words.ex_cn: 这珠宝是由纯钯制成的。
words.en: A chemical element with symbol Pd and atomic number 46, a rare and lustrous silvery-white metal discovered in 1803 by William Hyde Wollaston.

words.ex: Osmium is one of the densest elements known.
words.ex_cn: 锇是已知密度最大的元素之一。
words.en: Osmium is a hard, brittle, bluish-white transition metal in the platinum group that is found as a trace element in alloys, mostly in platinum ores. It is the densest naturally occurring element, with a density of 22.59 g/cm³.

words.ex: Iridium is a rare and highly corrosion-resistant transition metal.
words.ex_cn: 铱是一种稀有且高度耐腐蚀的过渡金属。
words.en: Iridium is a hard, brittle, lustrous, dense, transition metal of the platinum family, iridium is one of the rarest elements in the Earth's crust.

words.ex: The ring is made of platinum.
words.ex_cn: 这个戒指是铂金做的。
words.en: Platinum is a precious metal, silver-white in color, that is used especially in jewelry and in industry.

words.tr: n. 鎶（化学元素，符号Rf，原子序数104）
words.ex: Rotherfordium is a synthetic element not found in nature.
words.ex_cn: 𬬻是一种人造元素，自然界中不存在。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element with symbol Rf and atomic number 104. It is a highly radioactive, superheavy transition metal.

words.tr: n. 钅杜（化学元素，符号Db，原子序数105）
words.ex: Dubnium is a very rare chemical element.
words.ex_cn: 𬭊是一种非常稀有的化学元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element with symbol Db and atomic number 105. It is a highly radioactive, superheavy transition metal.

words.tr: n. 𨧀（化学元素，符号Sg，原子序数106）
words.ex: Seaborgium is a very rare element.
words.ex_cn: 𨭎是一种非常稀有的元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element with symbol Sg and atomic number 106. It is a highly radioactive, superheavy transition metal.

words.tr: n. 钅勃（化学元素，符号 Bh，原子序数 107）
words.ex: Bohrium is a rare synthetic element.
words.ex_cn: 𬭛是一种稀有的合成元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element (symbol Bh, atomic number 107).

words.tr: n. 鎶（化学元素，符号：Hs，原子序数：108）
words.ex: Hassium is a rare radioactive element.
words.ex_cn: 𨭆是一种稀有的放射性元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element (symbol Hs, atomic number 108).

words.tr: n. 金属元素，符号Mt，原子序数109
words.ex: Meitnerium is a very rare element.
words.ex_cn: 门捷列夫是一种非常稀有的元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element (symbol Mt, atomic number 109).

words.tr: n. 达姆施塔特ium（化学元素，符号Ds，原子序数110）
words.ex: Darmstadtium is a very rare element.
words.ex_cn: 达姆施塔特ium是一种非常稀有的元素。
words.en: A synthetic chemical element (symbol Ds, atomic number 110).

words.ex: Lanthanum is a rare earth element used in certain types of batteries.
words.ex_cn: 镧是一种用于某些类型电池的稀土元素。
words.en: Lanthanum is a soft, malleable, silvery-white metallic element of the lanthanide series, used in various applications including camera lenses and hydrogen storage.

words.ex: Cerium is a chemical element with the symbol Ce and atomic number 58.
words.ex_cn: 铈是一种化学元素，符号为Ce，原子序数为58。
words.en: Cerium is a soft, silvery, ductile metal which easily oxidizes in air. It is the most abundant of the rare earth elements and is found in a number of minerals, including allanite, monazite, and bastnäsite.

words.ex: Praseodymium is a rare earth metal used in certain types of glass.
words.ex_cn: 镨是一种用于某些类型玻璃的稀土金属。
words.en: Praseodymium is a chemical element with the symbol Pr and atomic number 59. It is a soft, silvery, malleable and ductile metal, valued for its magnetic, electrical, chemical, and optical properties.

words.ex: Neodymium magnets are known for their strong magnetic properties.
words.ex_cn: 钕磁铁以其强大的磁性而闻名。
words.en: A soft silvery metallic element of the rare earth group, used in the manufacture of strong permanent magnets and in various alloys.

words.ex: Promethium is a rare earth metal used in specialized applications.
words.ex_cn: 钷是一种用于特殊应用的稀土金属。
words.en: A radioactive chemical element with the symbol Pm and atomic number 61. It is a member of the lanthanide series and is not found naturally on Earth.

words.ex: Samarium is used in strong magnets.
words.ex_cn: 钐用于制造强磁铁。
words.en: A rare-earth metal (symbol Sm, atomic number 62).

words.ex: Europium is used in TV screens to make red light.
words.ex_cn: 铕用于电视屏幕中产生红光。
words.en: A soft silvery-white metallic element of the lanthanide series, used in the production of fluorescent lamps and as a neutron absorber in nuclear reactors.

words.ex: Gadolinium is used in MRI machines.
words.ex_cn: 钆用于核磁共振成像机器中。
words.en: Gadolinium is a chemical element with the symbol Gd and atomic number 64. It is a silvery-white, malleable, and ductile rare earth metal.

words.ex: Terbium is a rare element used in electronics.
words.ex_cn: 铽是一种用于电子产品的稀有元素。
words.en: Terbium is a silvery-white metallic element of the lanthanide series, used in solid-state devices and as a dopant in some types of lasers.

words.ex: Dysprosium is used in strong magnets.
words.ex_cn: 镝用于制造强磁铁。
words.en: Dysprosium is a chemical element with the symbol Dy and atomic number 66. It is a rare earth element with a metallic silver luster. Dysprosium is used in various applications, including in the manufacturing of data storage devices and in nuclear reactors as a control rod material.

words.ex: Holmium is a rare element used in some lasers.
words.ex_cn: 钬是一种用于某些激光器的稀有元素。
words.en: Holmium is a chemical element with the symbol Ho and atomic number 67. It is a rare-earth element and is used in various applications, including in nuclear reactors for its neutron-absorbing properties.

words.ex: Erbium is used in some lasers.
words.ex_cn: 铒用于某些激光器中。
words.en: A soft, silvery metallic element of the rare earth group, used in nuclear technology and as a dopant in optical fibers.

words.ex: Thulium is a rare element used in some medical lasers.
words.ex_cn: 铥是一种用于某些医疗激光的稀有元素。
words.en: Thulium is a chemical element with the symbol Tm and atomic number 69. It is a lanthanide, one of the rare earth elements, and is the thirteenth and third-last element in the lanthanide series.

words.ex: Ytterbium is a rare metal used in lasers.
words.ex_cn: 镱是一种用于激光的稀有金属。
words.en: A soft silvery metallic element of the rare earth group that is used especially in lasers and optical fibers.

words.ex: Lutetium is a rare earth metal with atomic number 71.
words.ex_cn: 镥是一种原子序数为71的稀土金属。
words.en: Lutetium is a chemical element with the symbol Lu and atomic number 71. It is a silvery white metal, which resists corrosion in dry air, but not in moist air. Lutetium is the last element in the lanthanide series, and it is traditionally counted among the rare earths.

words.ex: Actinium is a radioactive element used in some cancer treatments.
words.ex_cn: 锕是一种用于某些癌症治疗的放射性元素。
words.en: A radioactive chemical element with atomic number 89, discovered in 1899.

words.ex: Thorium is a radioactive element used in some nuclear reactors.
words.ex_cn: 钍是一种放射性元素，用于一些核反应堆中。
words.en: Thorium is a chemical element with the symbol Th and atomic number 90. It is a weakly radioactive metallic chemical element in the actinide series.

words.ex: Protactinium is a rare actinide element.
words.ex_cn: 镤是一种稀有的锕系元素。
words.en: Protactinium is a chemical element with the symbol Pa and atomic number 91. It is a dense, silvery-gray metal which readily reacts with oxygen, water vapor, and inorganic acids.

words.ex: He found uranium in the old rock sample.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧岩石样本中发现了铀。
words.en: A heavy, silvery-white metallic element, radioactive and toxic, used as a fuel in nuclear reactors and in the manufacture of nuclear weapons.

words.ex: Neptunium is a radioactive element with the atomic number 93.
words.ex_cn: 镎是一种原子序数为93的放射性元素。
words.en: A radioactive metallic element of the actinide series, discovered by bombarding uranium with neutrons.

words.tr: n. 钚（放射性化学元素）
words.ex: Plutonium is used in nuclear weapons.
words.ex_cn: 钚用于核武器。
words.en: A radioactive metallic element used especially as a fuel in nuclear reactors and as an explosive in nuclear weapons.

words.ex: Americium is a radioactive element used in smoke detectors.
words.ex_cn: 镅是一种用于烟雾探测器的放射性元素。
words.en: Americium is a radioactive chemical element with the symbol Am and atomic number 95. It is a transuranic member of the actinide series, in the periodic table located under the lanthanide element europium, and thus by analogy was named after the Americas.

words.ex: Curium is a radioactive element used in science.
words.ex_cn: 锔是一种用于科学的放射性元素。
words.en: Curium is a synthetic radioactive chemical element with the symbol Cm and atomic number 96. It is a transuranic element of the actinide series, named after Marie and Pierre Curie.

words.ex: Berkelium is a synthetic element with the symbol Bk.
words.ex_cn: 锫是一种合成元素，符号为 Bk。
words.en: Berkelium is a synthetic element with the symbol Bk and atomic number 97. It is a member of the actinide and transuranium element series.

words.ex: Californium is a radioactive chemical element with the symbol Cf.
words.ex_cn: 锎是一种放射性化学元素，符号为 Cf。
words.en: Californium is a radioactive chemical element with the symbol Cf and atomic number 98. It was first synthesized in 1950 at the University of California, Berkeley by bombarding curium with alpha particles.

words.ex: Einsteinium is a rare element in science labs.
words.ex_cn: 锿是一种在科学实验室中稀有的元素。
words.en: Einsteinium is a synthetic element with the symbol Es and atomic number 99. It is a member of the actinide series and is named after the physicist Albert Einstein.

words.ex: Fermium is a radioactive element used in science.
words.ex_cn: 镄是一种用于科学的放射性元素。
words.en: Fermium is a synthetic element with the symbol Fm and atomic number 100. It is an actinide and the heaviest element that can be formed by neutron bombardment of lighter elements, and hence the last element that can be prepared in macroscopic quantities, although pure fermium metal has not yet been prepared.

words.ex: Mendelevium is a synthetic element with atomic number 101.
words.ex_cn: 钔是一种原子序数为101的人造元素。
words.en: Mendelevium is a synthetic element in the periodic table that has the symbol Md and atomic number 101. It is a metallic radioactive transuranic element in the actinide series, usually synthesized by bombarding einsteinium with alpha particles.

words.ex: Nobelium is a synthetic element with the symbol No and atomic number 102.
words.ex_cn: 锘是一种合成元素，化学符号为No，原子序数为102。
words.en: Nobelium is a synthetic chemical element with the symbol No and atomic number 102. It is named in honor of Alfred Nobel.

words.ex: Lawrencium is a synthetic chemical element with the symbol Lr and atomic number 103.
words.ex_cn: 铹是一种合成化学元素，符号为Lr，原子序数为103。
words.en: Lawrencium is a synthetic chemical element with the symbol Lr and atomic number 103. It is named in honor of Ernest Lawrence, inventor of the cyclotron, a device that was used to discover many artificial radioactive elements.
